mechanism: At session start (SymbolInfoSessionTrade), accumulate high/low over RangeMinutes (default 15) into CRangeCapture; freeze orHigh/orLow when window ends and draw the corridor as rectangle + horizontals. Alternative Method 1 uses yesterday’s last M1 bar extremes unioned with today’s first M1 bar. Intraday price relative to the fixed opening corridor is the session regime scaffold (inside vs outside).
data_needed: Session from/to via SymbolInfoSessionTrade; M1 (or TF) highs/lows for RangeMinutes; bid/close; midnight reset of state.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 backtest; AUDUSD M5; any sessioned FX/futures
why_new_for_mis: Defines a session-local structural regime from early-session extremes only—MIS can tag inside-range vs breakout days without classical indicators.
quote: These bounds serve both as visual landmarks and precise trigger levels. Only when price breaks beyond the rectangle, revisits that boundary, and breaks out again does the strategy confirm entry

mechanism: State machine: after range defined, require close outside orHigh/orLow (OnBreak); then require a revisit that tags the boundary (low≤orHigh for longs / high≥orLow for shorts); then require a second close beyond the boundary (CheckRetest). ATR×multiplier must be meaningful before signals fire; SL/TP sized from ATR. Filters unconfirmed spikes.
data_needed: Closed MqlRates close/high/low; g_range High/Low; iATR(TF, ATRPeriod)×ATRMultiplier; retest flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15; AUDUSD M5 Strategy Tester
why_new_for_mis: Two-step closed-bar breakout authenticity sensor: change is only accepted after break→retest→re-break under ATR context—reduces false regime flips for MIS.
quote: the EA watches for a two-step breakout: first, price must close outside the range; next, it must retrace back to the boundary and then close beyond it again (the “retest”)

mechanism: Maintain velHistory[VelocityHistoryBars] of ask prices; delta = priceNow − oldest. Build signed deltas vs history, sort, pick threshold at VelocityPctile (default 120% → extreme end of window). okVel if |delta| exceeds that percentile threshold—only unusually large moves pass.
data_needed: Rolling ask history array; VelocityHistoryBars (~96); VelocityPctile; ComputeVelocityPercentile sort/index.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Boom 900 Index backtest; Boom/Crash synthetic indices; MainTF bar-close
why_new_for_mis: Distributional velocity spike sensor (percentile of recent price deltas) rather than fixed pip thresholds—portable extreme-move detector for MIS vol/impulse state.
quote: Measures the price change over VelocityHistoryBars and compares it to a historical percentile threshold-only “unusually large” moves pass.

mechanism: Fire BOOM/CRASH only when all layers concur: velocity percentile pass; ATR_now > ATR_prev×ATRMultiplier (surge); SMA direction aligns with delta sign; optional pivot-zone filter (price still on wrong side of prior HLC/3 ± ZoneBufferPoints); optional session-hour gate. Layered confirmation mirrors multi-sensor threat validation.
data_needed: iATR two-bar buffer; iMA two-bar SMA; prior bar H/L/C pivot; session start/end hours; velocity okVel.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Boom 900; MainTF with optional ATRTF/TrendTF; session filter hours
why_new_for_mis: Composite impulse-change sensor: volatility expansion + directional MA + mean-reversion zone + clock gate—MIS can require multi-layer concurrence before tagging a spike event.
quote: A rolling velocity window determines whether the current price impulse eclipses recent behaviour; an ATR-based surge multiplier confirms that volatility has expanded meaningfully; and moving-average trend filters validate directional bias.

mechanism: On closed bar: TR=max(H−L,|H−Cprev|,|L−Cprev|); ATR=arithmetic mean of last atrPeriod TRs. Classify mutually exclusively: LR if TR≥largeMult×ATR (default 1.5); else SR if TR≤smallMult×ATR (0.5); else IB if H<Hprev and L>Lprev; else OB if H>Hprev and L<Lprev. Magnitude rules precede containment rules.
data_needed: OHLC arrays (atrPeriod+3 bars); largeMult/smallMult; closed bar shift=1 only (non-repaint).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index M5; Crash 1000; Boom 1000; ATR-portable across FX/CFD/crypto/indices
why_new_for_mis: Four-state bar volatility taxonomy (expand/compress/contain/engulf) normalized by ATR—clean discrete regime labels for MIS without oscillator lag.
quote: A sudden range expansion often indicates aggressive participation from large players; a prolonged contraction suggests liquidity is being withdrawn anticipating the next move.

mechanism: Treat sequences of Small-Range bars as compression/coiling; a subsequent Large-Range bar flags expansion/breakout energy. Live CRT display shows narrow inside/SR clusters then broad-range eruptions—volatility-cycle change sensor from the taxonomy stream.
data_needed: Per-bar CRT flags over recent history; optional clustering count of consecutive SR/IB before LR.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index live 5-minute CRT_EA; Boom/Crash charts
why_new_for_mis: Compression→expansion transition detector built from CRT states—MIS change event when quiet SR clusters resolve into LR participation.
quote: Quiet, narrow “inside” bars cluster together, then suddenly a broad‑range candle erupts, signaling a burst of momentum. … Markets rarely stay quiet indefinitely; clustering SR bars often marks the pause before a new expansion

mechanism: Ingest OHLC history to Python; engineer spike magnitude, MACD divergence, RSI, ATR, Kalman-filter last/5-bar slope, envelope bands, and Prophet future-delta; train per-symbol gradient-boosting (or RF) classifiers with Prophet models cached ~1h; /analyze serves live spike probabilities. Spike label example: range > 2× rolling-50 mean range.
data_needed: Chunked JSON OHLC uploads (<14 MiB); parquet per symbol; ta MACD/RSI/ATR; pykalman; Prophet/cmdstanpy; sklearn Pipeline.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Crash 1000 Index M1; Boom 1000 Index M1; ~4990-bar chunks
why_new_for_mis: Explicit ML spike sensor stack: classical TA + Kalman slope + Prophet delta fused into a cached classifier—neural/sequence sensing of Boom/Crash impulse risk for MIS.
quote: computing spike magnitude, MACD divergence, RSI, ATR, Kalman‑derived trend slopes, envelope bands, and Prophet‑based future deltas—all in one place.

mechanism: Per TF over ssWindow closed bars: CBR=(|C−O|/range)×dir; CPP=(((C−L)/range)−0.5)×2×dir; VAD=clamp((range/ATR)−1,−1,3); ss=0.4·CBR+0.3·CPP+0.3·VAD then ×confFactor (prior bar same dir) ×volFactor (quiet if avgRange/ATR < threshold). Average samples → TF score×100; fuse primary/extra TFs by normalized weights; EMA-smooth with alpha → scalar in [−100,+100] with ±zone labels.
data_needed: CopyRates per TF; iATR handles; InpLookback/InpSSWindow; weights; InpSmoothAlpha; InpPositiveZone/InpNegativeZone.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Crash 300 M5 backtest; Crash 1000 live; multi-TF default M5+M15+H1
why_new_for_mis: Auditable short-term tilt regime from candle micro-features fused across TFs and smoothed—single continuous bias coordinate for MIS without DOM.
quote: Sentiment here is the market’s short-term tilt — the net push toward buying or selling in recent candles. STM measures that tilt directly from price action by converting each closed candle into a small, interpretable score.

mechanism: Accept BUY/SELL on smoothed-score sign flip only if |smooth|≥InpMinSignFlipAbs, RecentSmoothedSignHold(InpSignFlipHoldBars) all share new sign, and optional momentum ≥InpMinMomentum; also alert on |Δsmooth|≥InpFlipThreshold abrupt flips. Anchors markers to closed primary-bar time/price.
data_needed: Circular g_hist_buffer of smoothed scores; flip/zone thresholds; hold bars; momentum gate.
why_new_for_mis: Regime-change detector on the tilt scalar with magnitude, persistence, and momentum gates—MIS change events that reject single-bar flicker.
quote: it also checks for sign flips … and applies three acceptance tests: minimum absolute magnitude of the new smoothed value … recent sign hold … and optional momentum

mechanism: OnTick BufAdd into fixed ring (time/bid/ask/last/vol); Mid prefers last else (bid+ask)/2. VWAP(minutes)=Σ(price×vol)/Σvol over ticks with time≥now−minutes (default 1440). Price above VWAP = premium/bullish participation bias; below = discount. DOM proxy when book unavailable.
data_needed: MqlTick stream; ring size InpRingSize; volume_real fallback to volume or 1; InpVWAPminutes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol with ticks; illustrated with swing/liquidity diagrams
why_new_for_mis: Rolling tick-reconstructed VWAP as live fair-value / liquidity-consensus anchor for MIS when true order book is absent.
quote: this tool reconstructs a VWAP line derived solely from incoming tick data. This approach enables traders to access insights comparable to those gained from order book “fair value zones”

mechanism: Flow(sec)=(upticks−downticks)/(upticks+downticks) over ticks in last InpImbWindowSec (tick-count imbalance in [−1,1]; optional volume-weighted signed vol variant). SpreadPips=(ask−bid)/point; cheap if spread < ATR_pips×InpCheapSpreadFrac. Alerts only when cheap AND |flow|≥InpFlowTh with hysteresis reset at Th×HystFactor.
data_needed: Ring Acc with flowNeeded; iATR; SymbolInfoTick spread; InpFlowTh/InpFlowHystFactor/InpCheapSpreadFrac.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Live MT5 panel examples with large ATR instruments; timer cadence InpTimerSec
why_new_for_mis: Microstructure liquidity pair: short-horizon aggressor flow plus cost-of-immediacy filter—MIS can gate directional pressure on tradable (cheap) spreads.
quote: Its signals can be filtered against predefined spread thresholds, helping traders avoid entries during periods when transaction costs are unusually elevated.

mechanism: On each new closed bar: detect fractal high/low at window center (g_length=2·p+1 odd; center ≥ all neighbors). Store unmarked anchors. CrossedOver/Under of prevClose→curClose vs fractal price marks event once: if os_state was opposite → ChoCH (early bias loss); else BOS (structure break). Update os_state ±1. Closed-bar only, non-repainting.
data_needed: iHigh/iLow/iClose/iTime; g_length (auto by TF or LengthInput); bull/bear time/price/marked arrays; MaxFractalHistoryBars prune.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; Step Index H1/M1; Volatility 75 (1s) M1 live
why_new_for_mis: Two-tier market-structure change sensor: ChoCH as early regime-weakening warning, BOS as confirmed directional structure shift—auditable closed-bar events for MIS.
quote: ChoCH (Change of Character), which flags when the market is losing its prior bias … and BOS (Break of Structure), which confirms that the bias has shifted when price decisively closes beyond a prior swing high or low.

mechanism: Over InpBars (~1200): build DNAMetrics—wick/body avg, pct close-near-high/low, pct doji, atr_norm, pct spikes, vol_clustering, swing_cycle_bars_avg, fractal_density, breakout_follow_through, retr_38/50/62 freqs, asia/london/ny range shares, smoothness_index. DNAVector→17-dim; CosineDistance and NormalizedL2 vs prior snapshot; mutation if either exceeds InpMutationThresh / InpMutationL2Thresh—regime shift alert with top metric deltas.
data_needed: CopyRates ≥300; ATR cache; fractal depth swings; retracement window; session hour bounds; prior DNAMetrics.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 (~1200 bars); GBPUSD H1 comparison; London-dominant range share
why_new_for_mis: Instrument fingerprint + explicit mutation distance as regime and regime-change sensor—MIS can track structural identity drift (ATR, sessions, retracements, smoothness) beyond single indicators.
quote: A mutation is a significant change in the EA’s market fingerprint, flagged when the cosine or normalized L2 distance between the previous and current DNAMetrics exceeds the set thresholds—and usually means a regime shift

mechanism: From fractal swings, for opposite-direction impulses scan forward InpRetrWindowBars for max retracement ratio; bucket into ~38%/50%/62%/>70% frequencies and avg_max_retr. Separately, ComputeBreakoutFollowThrough: after swing break, success if extension ≥ InpFT_ATR_Mult×ATR. Together quantify typical pullback depth and breakout reliability for the symbol/TF.
data_needed: Swing array from BuildSwings; ATR at swing; InpRetrLookbackSwings; InpFT_ATR_Mult.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 (171 swings, ~98% FT); GBPUSD H1 (~94% FT)
why_new_for_mis: Empirical structural expectancy sensors—how deep corrections usually go and how often breakouts follow through—feed MIS with instrument-specific pullback/breakout character.
quote: Retracement histograms show how deep corrections typically are after impulses on the symbol/timeframe—essential for setting realistic targets and deciding whether a “pullback to 50%” is a probable edge.

mechanism: From selected bar window (lookback or chart date range), typical price TP=(H+L+C)/3 → mean, sample stdev, median, P25/P75, ModeBinned, ModeKDE. Latest TP z-score=(TP−mean)/stdev; enter long if z≥ZScoreSignalEnter, short if z≤−enter, exit toward ZScoreSignalExit. Drawn levels act as statistical S/R. Optional volume-weighted mean.
data_needed: CopyRates in selection; ModeBins/KDEGridPoints/KDEBandwidthFactor; z enter/exit thresholds; optional ATR thresholds for touch/break.
why_new_for_mis: Turns the empirical price distribution into on-chart regime levels plus a z-score extremity sensor—MIS mean-reversion/expansion state from the local density, not fixed pivots.
quote: Statistical measures computed from price data, such as mean, median, percentiles, and density-based modes, capture the central tendency and distributional shape of recent price action. These metrics often coincide with key reaction areas in the market

mechanism: SnapshotReferenceLevels freezes mean/P25/P75/median/modes/stdev as RefLevel set; MonitorReferenceLevels tracks touch (within TouchTolerancePips or ATR×mult), then classifies breakout vs reversal over MonitorBars using BreakoutPips/ReversalPips and optional close confirmation; scores levels by touch count, avg touch volume, persistence.
data_needed: Frozen level prices; live rates; pip/ATR thresholds; RefLevel touch/result fields; CSV export.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: On-chart Statistical Dashboard live monitoring after Snapshot
why_new_for_mis: Converts static statistical levels into live change events (touch→break vs reverse) with persistence scoring—MIS can watch which distributional zones are actively being tested.
quote: Snapshot reference levels for live monitoring (touch, breakout, and reversal detection).

mechanism: Scan LookbackBars for Pinbar (small body, long tail), Engulfing (body covers prior), Doji (tiny body). For each hit record: next-bar same-direction success; any same-dir within LookAheadBars; breakout of pattern high/low by BreakoutPips with confirm bars. Report Next%/Within%/Breakout-success% per pattern (and volume-weighted variants). Instrument-specific reliability map.
data_needed: OHLC+volume over lookback; PinbarBodyPct/TailPct; DojiBodyPct; LookAheadBars; BreakoutPips/ConfirmBars; optional CSV.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Step Index (Pin 40.2%, Eng 31.7%, Doji 65.1%); Boom 300 (Eng 40%, Pin 42.1%, Doji 78.6%)
why_new_for_mis: Empirical pattern-reliability sensor per symbol/TF—MIS can weight candle-pattern evidence by measured follow-through instead of assuming universal pattern meaning.
quote: This EA is built as a probability analyst; it scans historical bars and quantifies how often each pattern leads to continuation, reversal, or successful breakouts on a particular pair and timeframe.

mechanism: Manual VWMA=Σ(close×tick_volume)/Σ(tick_volume) over FastPeriod/SlowPeriod. On new bar: bull if f_prev<s_prev and f_now>s_now; bear if f_prev>s_prev and f_now<s_now. Optional ValidateSR: buy only if bid≥LowestLow(SR_LookBack)+offset; sell only if ask≤HighestHigh−offset. Volume-weights the MA so crosses reflect participation-backed trend shifts.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart TF backtests with on-chart VWMA polylines and arrows
why_new_for_mis: Volume-weighted dual-MA cross as a liquidity-aware trend-change sensor—MIS gets participation-emphasized regime flips vs price-only SMA/EMA crosses.
quote: the VWMA gives greater weight to periods with higher trading activity. … Buy (bullish) signals are generated when the fast VWMA crosses above the slow VWMA.

mechanism: User enters a price level; over BarsToCheck: touch if High≥L−TouchPips×pip AND Low≤L+TouchPips×pip; bullish touch if close>level else bearish if close<level. Bullish breakout if PrevClose<L and Close>L+BreakPips×pip; bearish mirror. Empirical P(bull touch), P(bear touch), P(bull/bear break); bias=Support if bull metrics dominate, Resistance if bear dominate, else Neutral.
data_needed: Numeric level; BarsToCheck; TouchPips; BreakPips; historical H/L/C; pip from digits.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 demo; GBPUSD H1 1.34244 case study Apr–Oct 2025; Gold 1950 example
why_new_for_mis: Turns any candidate level into a quantified support/resistance/neutral regime profile from historical touch/break frequencies—MIS can score level structural role objectively.
quote: Count of bullish and bearish touches — how often price tested the level from each side; Count of confirmed breakouts — how many times price decisively crossed it; Probabilities describing the directional bias of those events; An aggregated bias reading that classifies the level as Support, Resistance, or Neutral.
